scope: Lazada Affiliate -> 2 websites -> 2 respective Facebook Fanpages

requirements.productEligibility: Only API products with a verified tracking link; do not invent links or guarantee commission.
requirements.socialDelivery: Publish a selected product summary from the matching website; not one Facebook post per imported product; first check scheduled and published posts.
requirements.antiLoop: Never repost Facebook-origin content as website-to-Facebook output

Bind verified food feed to existing Ăn Ngon Có Deal CMS with separate deduped product store
Connect PC website new approved items to Metricool without touching 17 existing pending posts
Connect food approved items via website -> RSS -> Zapier -> Buffer; only after anti-duplicate and food feed verification

Check published URLs, photos, category, mobile rendering, no 404, and commission/report attribution
note: This contract tracks readiness, not activation. Editing this file does not grant Lazada approval or deploy an integration.
